title_en: The People of the Night Window
note_en: 不管 A，都 B means "no matter what A is, B still happens": the condition can be anything, and the result doesn't depend on it. Options are joined with 还是: 不管是东北的冰，还是南方的热，列车第二天早上都要准时出发 "whether it's ice in the northeast or heat in the south, the trains still have to leave on time the next morning." A yes-or-no question can replace the list: 不管乘客知不知道，他都觉得… "whether or not the passengers know, he still feels…." The order is fixed: 不管 with the condition first, then 都 before the verb.
